verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Meilisearch's pricing model: no flat-rate, resource-based or usage-based terms and no statement about per-request charges. The pricing-page items cover only features and a 14-day trial. Community reports point the other way, describing a jump from the free tier to a $1200/month plan and RAM needs that became 'too unpredictable and expensive' under heavy search traffic. Cheap self-hosted deployments on fixed hardware are a user-side arrangement, not a documented pricing guarantee.

support.subject: As a founder, costs stay predictable as records and query volume grow — no surprise per-request cliffs
